root_cause.text: The driver frees DMA buffers before draining the message queue on unbind, causing a use-after-free when subsequent queue operations access the already-released buffers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `pch_free_dma_buf(board_dat, data)` call from before the loop that waits for pending messages to complete to after that loop and after freeing the IRQ, ensuring DMA buffers are not freed while the queue may still be using them.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove DMA buffer cleanup from remove function to fix potential use-after-free or double-free issues.

bic_trace_step.reason: In the remove function pch_spi_pd_remove, pch_free_dma_buf is called before setting STATUS_EXITING and waiting for the message queue to drain (lines after `if (use_dma) pch_free_dma_buf(board_dat, data);`). This ordering means DMA buffers can be freed while a transfer may still be in progress, leading to a use-after-free when queue operations access the already-released DMA buffers. The code lacks any mechanism to ensure all pending transfers are complete before freeing DMA buffers.
